# Crownly

> Crownly is a premium iOS marketplace for buying and selling authenticated luxury watches.

Crownly connects collectors and verified sellers for high-value timepieces. The app includes curated discovery, search and filters, in-app offers and messaging, Stripe Connect escrow checkout (Apple Pay, card, and wire), AI-assisted trust verification, Authenticity Passports, a personal watch collection, Grail Board want-list matching, a watch scanner, Crownly Stories editorial, and Shopify inventory sync for dealers.

## Official links

- Website: https://crownly.art
- Stories: https://crownly.art/stories
- Privacy Policy: https://crownly.art/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://crownly.art/terms
- Support: hello@crownly.art
- Privacy: privacy@crownly.art

## Product summary

- Platform: iOS (App Store launch)
- Categories: Luxury watches, pre-owned and new, authenticated listings
- Brands: Rolex, Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet, Richard Mille, Cartier, Omega, Tudor, IWC, and more
- Payments: Stripe Connect escrow; Apple Pay, card, bank wire for high-value sales
- Seller fee: 7% on escrow-protected sales (launch partners may qualify for promotional rates)
- Trust: Seller KYC, AI listing review, trust scores, verification badges, Authenticity Passports
- Key features: Discover feed, search, sell flow, offers, messages, collection tracking, Grail Board, watch scanner, push alerts
- Dealers: Shopify OAuth integration, automatic product import, inventory webhooks, seller settings hub
- Content: Crownly Stories — editorial feed with engagement in-app and on the web
